description: A clock whose tempo is typed in digit by digit, shown on the display in beats per minute

params.text: Sets the hundreds digit of the tempo
Sets the tens digit of the tempo
Sets the units digit of the tempo
Sets the hundredths of the tempo, -0.64 to +0.64
Sets how far the fader can bend the tempo, 1 to 50
Sends the clock back to the beginning
Bends the tempo away from the typed figure, by as much as the RANGE knob allows

inputs.text: Sets the tempo outright, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 1000 beats per minute
Moves the fader in place of the mouse
A trigger here sends the clock back to the beginning

outputs.text: A trigger when the clock is sent back to the beginning
The clock tick, a sixteenth note by default
The tempo as a voltage, 0V to 10V covering 0 to 1000 beats per minute

menu: 1/4 Notes, 1/8 Notes, 1/16 Notes, 1/32 Notes and 1/64 Notes — set the rate of the clock output against the tempo
Gate Length — sets how long each clock pulse lasts, in milliseconds
OSC On — sends the tempo out over OSC as a /bpm message to localhost
OSC Port 7013, OSC Port 8013, OSC Port 9013 and OSC Port 10013 — set the port the tempo is sent to

inputs.6: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
